title: 3D photothermal hydrogels derived from spinel CoMn2O4@MXene nanocomposites for an efficient solar-driven evaporation system
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17522-17535
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00897F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Muneerah Alomar, Lamia Abu El Maati, Muhammad Sultan Irshad, Naila Arshad, Afraa Alotaibi, Naveed Mushtaq, Van-Duong Dao, Xianbao Wang
This study reports CoMn2O4@MXene hydrogels, which promote an efficient solar-driven evaporation system (1.45 kg m−2 h−1) and salt rejection, ensuring long-term stability.
